svg.title: Shishapangma — mountain relief
svg.desc: Northern Tibetan panorama. Main and central summit ridge, northern snow basins and fluted glacial buttresses. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Hiroki Ogawa. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:8,013m_Shishapangma_Tibet_China_%E8%A5%BF%E8%97%8F_%E5%B8%8C%E5%A4%8F%E9%82%A6%E9%A9%AC%E5%B3%B0_-_panoramio.jpg. License: CC BY 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
